findings.title: Documentation inaccurately states that the Operator fails unless `rolling-updates` is enabled
findings.body: The caution block states: "While on preview stage, the feature `rolling-updates` must be enabled. Otherwise, the {project_name} Operator will fail." and the example below enables `rolling-updates` for `strategy: Recreate|<not set>`. However, the Operator does not validate or require the `rolling-updates` server feature flag for the default (`<not set>`) or `Recreate` strategies, and it does not fail when the feature is disabled (as also seen in `UpgradeTest.createInitialDeployment`, which leaves the feature disabled when `updateStrategy` is `null`). This misleads users into thinking the Operator will fail unless `rolling-updates` is enabled on their deployments.

findings.title: `testFeatureNotEnabled` does not cover the `check` subcommand or assert exit codes
findings.body: This PR gates both `UpdateCompatibilityMetadata` (`metadata`) and `UpdateCompatibilityCheck` (`check`) behind the `rolling-updates` feature flag and changes `CompatibilityResult` exit codes (`RECREATE_UPGRADE_EXIT_CODE` changed from 4 to 3, and `FEATURE_DISABLED = 4` was added). However, `testFeatureNotEnabled` only invokes the `metadata` subcommand (not `check`) and never asserts that the process exit code matches `CompatibilityResult.FEATURE_DISABLED` (nor does `testWrongVersions` assert `CompatibilityResult.RECREATE_UPGRADE_EXIT_CODE`).
